# CANDIDATE: shotgun_scalper_stage5_keeper_top

**Filed:** 2026-07-22

## Hypothesis

We are trying to capture edge by adjusting exit parameters (take profit, stop loss, time stop, chandelier arm) and entry filters (strike offset, volume ratio). The edge exists because the original shotgun_scalper parameters were not optimized for J's anchor days, leading to insufficient capture on winner days and excessive losses on loser days.

## Mechanism

Enter on shotgun_scalper signal with:
- strike_offset: 2 (OTM-2 for puts, aligned with J's put-biased anchor days)
- vol_ratio_threshold: 1.2 (require 1.2x average volume to enter, filtering low-vol noise)
- tp_premium_pct: 0.75 (take profit at 75% premium gain for first 2/3 of position)
- stop_premium_pct: -0.35 (stop loss at 35% premium loss for full position)
- time_stop_min: 12 (exit all if no profit within 12 minutes, preventing stagnation)
- chandelier_arm_pct: 0.6 (arm chandelier profit-lock at 60% gain, trailing 15% off HWM to lock runner gains)

Exit on TP1, stop, time stop, or chandelier trail whichever occurs first.
